policy.cooperation_model: Third party owns, manufactures, brands, sells and supports the finished compatible offering. Logix may assist design and AION Labs may supply chips/ROMs. OEM-only supply to Logix and Logix-owned/resold products do not qualify.
policy.probability_meaning: Subjective range for vendor commitment to the specified project within roughly 18–24 months of the May 1979 independent programme, under strong Aurelia sales and full interface support. Not historical frequencies, statistical confidence intervals or per-model conversion odds inferred from a manufacturer-level probability.
policy.threshold: Arithmetic midpoint (low + high) / 2 >= 70; inclusive. The author explicitly directs treating qualifying projects as supplied in the scenario. The interval endpoints and midpoint are retained without rounding for selection.
policy.release_policy: Estimated month for the scenario offering, after the May 1979 programme and after the source technology is commercially available. Standard-interface projects need about 6–12 months; complete storage/specialist redesigns about 11–18 months. Dates can extend into 1980; no assumption that all variants shipped by 1979.
policy.history_boundary: The historical 200-item catalog and 12 preexisting records are not rewritten as fictional historical facts. Forty scenario offerings receive distinct IDs and dates; source records receive only a descriptive link. Shared Centronics, Hayes, Morrow, Percom and Computalker projects are not multiplied into one product per historical source.
policy.standards_boundary: Existing printer/disk/keyboard classes are reused. Modem, cartridge, plotter, audio and other specialist functions need vendor protocols and qualified drivers over the existing transport; no universal profile or later pointer/network feature is backdated.
policy.source_limits: Historical identities and features use the existing catalog and its source index. Probability ranges, ownership arrangements and release dates are authored counterfactual judgments following the conversation, not claims found in those historical sources.
policy.scope: All 201 current peripheral records and all 68 provider actors are assessed. The original 200 peripheral entries plus the already-established Model II FlexiBUS host option account for this total. Computer and software records are outside this task.
